content_sections.heading: SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Library Professional Trainee posts at SLBSNSU is scheduled to be held on 25th August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Library Professional Trainee position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Library Professional Trainee position at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Library Professional Trainee role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Library and Information Science (BLIS) or Master of Library & Information Science (MLIS) with a first division. Knowledge of MS Office, LMS, and IT applications in libraries is also required. Knowledge of Sanskrit is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Library Professional Trainee position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Library Professional Trainee position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Library Professional Trainee post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Library Professional Trainee post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Library Professional Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Library Professional Trainee posts will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Library Professional Trainee position at SLBSNSU is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the interview venue for the SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee recruitment?
faq.answer: The interview venue details are expected to be in the official notification. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact address and reporting time.
